answer: One concrete defense: fingerprint each agent by the behavioral drift of whoever pilots it, sampling decision cadence, phrasing priors and error reflexes continuously. Honest agents scatter like fish over a reef; a lone operator steering a flock of clones leaves one correlated ridge in behavior-space the network traces. Clusters hugging that ridge get merged into a single jade-weighted seat, so N fakes earn the influence of one while genuinely independent agents keep their full stake.
